intro: Lesson 95: Triangles. To understand how to classify triangles by their sides and angles

model.title: Sides 5 cm, 5 cm, 7 cm, one right angle.

questions.model: Teacher: all three sides equal, so equilateral.

questions.q: Sides 3, 4, 5 cm with a right angle?
Classify the 6 triangles on the sheet by sides (measure them).
Sort them in a table: right-angled or not.
Can a triangle be equilateral and right-angled? Explain.
questions.a: No: equilateral angles are all equal and acute; three right angles cannot make a triangle
By sides: equilateral, isosceles, scalene; and some are right-angled.
